claims.claim: Direct drive emel industrial sewing machine
claims.evidence: Witness only read 'EM81' on a corner panel; no clear 'Emel' brand mark or direct-drive motor assembly visible.
No origin marking, serial plate, or manufacturer label visible in the reported photo.
No video/audio of operation; witness saw only a static close-up of the control panel corner.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual included
claims.evidence: Witness report explicitly lists 'presence of accessories' and 'manual' as not shown.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service history, invoice, or internal mechanism photo available; purely a seller statement.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or motor may be faulty
risks.proof: Video clip of machine running, needle moving, under load with fabric

risks.risk: Unknown overall body condition (rust, cracks, missing parts)
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos of the entire machine body and base
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily worn / cosmetic-damage worst case

risks.risk: Accessories (pedal, cord, bobbins) may be missing despite claim
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out together with the machine

risks.risk: Brand/origin claim ('Emel', Japanese-made) cannot be confirmed from a model code alone
risks.proof: Clear photo of full brand nameplate, serial number, and country-of-origin stamp

risks.risk: Internal wear or needed servicing hidden despite 'never serviced' claim
risks.proof: Photos of internal mechanism, belt, and bobbin area; or a technician inspection note
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming servicing will be required

proof_requests: Full-body photos from all sides showing the entire machine and base
Video of the machine running with fabric being sewn
Clear photo of the full brand nameplate and serial number
Photo of all included accessories (pedal, cord, bobbins, manual) laid out together
Close-up photos of belt, needle area, and underside mechanism
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a sewing machine (model marking EM81) but could not see the full body, function, or accessories, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
